#| label: fig-movement-matrix
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10.5



targets::tar_read(plotdata_movement_matrix) |>
  plot_matrix_movement() +

  scale_color_mpxnyc(name = "To Borough", option = "dark") +
  scale_size_mpxnyc() +
  theme_mpxnyc_matrix_movement()
